messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a concrete API/telemetry contract for the new econ 'burn-rate' dashboard (cost per 1k tokens, cache/batch savings breakdowns). Cross-team: infra/runtime + console + product. Can we align on fields today? :eyes:

 dylan: +1. I can take runtime event shape. Important: include model_variant, seq_len, quantization, backend (gpu/cpu), routing_tier

 cheng: Re: runtime tags — please add cache_hit:true/false and batch_size integer. Also useful to emit kv_cache_bytes and prefix_hit boolean.

 lara: For the console, we need both aggregated metrics (per-model per-hour) and raw samples for sampling. UX wants top contributors to cost (model, client-route, quant). Also a field for request_type (chat/generate/embed).

 maria: Good. Let's propose a minimal event payload and an extended payload. Minimal should support unit-cost and 1k-token rollups.

 dylan: draft minimal payload:
```
{ "event":"infer_complete",
  "model":"redwood-1-small",
  "tokens":42,
  "cost_micros":12345,
  "seq_len":512,
  "cache_hit":false
}
```

 cheng: For extended add: batch_size, kv_cache_bytes, prefix_hit, quant_level, backend, routing_policy.

 console-team: For the ingest API: please include customer_tier and route_id to allow per-route dashboards and quota comparators. Also want normalized cost_per_1k_tokens computed by backend or a tag to mark precomputed_cost.

 lara: UX question — should we show cache savings as absolute micros or as percent? Product prefers percent + absolute for transparency.

 maria: Action items: dylan to add events to runtime by EOD, cheng to update log schema in infra repo, console-team to draft dashboard panels and wireframe by Thursday.

 dylan: I'll emit both raw cost_micros and a derived cost_per_1k field (computed client-side before send) to simplify queries.

 cheng: Note: don't forget fallback routing hits (when model downgraded) — we need routed_from and routed_to fields for rollouts tracing.

 infra-bot: deploy pipeline note — telemetry-schema PRs require infra review + perf test. ETA for review slot: 48h.

 maria: Agree. Priority: accurate unit economics first, then savings breakdowns. Keep payload small for high-throughput paths (sampling throttle: 1%)

 dylan: will add sampling hint: sample_rate float between 0-1 on the event

 console-team: We'll add a toggle in console to show sampled vs extrapolated numbers and a tooltip explaining sampling.

 lara: I'll prep interaction flows for canary rollouts: show route-level cost delta vs baseline and a revert button link to rollout UI.

 maria: Final note — keep field names snake_case, avoid nested objects in minimal payload. If anyone wants another field, speak now.

 dylan: 👍 will open a PR: runtime: add infer_complete event + docs

 cheng: i'll create infra/telemetry/schema.md update and reference the PR.

 maria: Thanks everyone — moving to #design for wireframes after console-team posts mockups. :rocket:
